end.summary:
Reyansh practised identifying top, front and side views of solids.
They showed the top, front and side view of solids on practice and a new question.
They practised matching views to objects; this still needs checking in new examples.
They practised why views change by place; the cup-handle idea still needs checking.
The mix-up that another person sees the same view was not corrected at the last time it appeared.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing what objects look like from the top, front and side. They used the visible outline, such as a circle for a ball from above and a rectangle for a closed cupboard from the side. They sometimes mixed up what is visible from another person’s place and what is part of the object; this was not corrected after the last example. At home, place a cup or toy between two people and ask each person to name only the parts visible from their own place.
